Packaging claim: The Elevator Star Marks the Main Entry Floor in the U.S.
Core fact: U.S. accessibility standards identify the main entry floor control with a tactile star symbol.
Second reveal: The same standards assign standardized tactile symbols to controls such as door open, door close, alarm, and phone.
First-frame and mechanism proof: Close-up of an elevator panel with the star beside one floor button, then reveal the lobby/main entrance.
